questions.question: 4. A ship starts from a point with a velocity of $15 \mathrm{kmhr}^{-1}$ towards the north. At the beginning of its motion, another ship was observed at a distance of $10 \mathrm{~km}$ east of the first. If the second ship moves westward with a velocity of $20 \mathrm{kmhr}^{-1}$, how inuch time should lapse before they are at minimum distance? What will be the minimum distance between them?

questions.question:
6. In a college, out of 80 students of class XI, 20 play football, 25 play cricket and 10 play both football and cricket. Out of them, one student is selected at random.
(i) If he plays cricket, what is the probability of his playing football?
(ii) If he plays football, what is the probability of his playing cricket?

questions.question: 1. The half-life of radioactive radon is 3.8 days. How long will it take for 30% of the original atomic number to decay?

questions.subject: Physics(8)
questions.question: 2. A Carnot refrigerator takes heat from water at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and discards it to a room at a temperature of $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. If $100 \mathrm{~kg}$ of water at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ is to be changed to ice at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, what is the work required? [Latent heat of ice $=$ $3.4 \times 10^{5} \mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{kg}$ ]

questions.subject: Physics(8)
questions.question: 4. A person aged 25 years gets into a spacecraft and returns after 30 years travelling at the velocity of $1.8 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$. What is his current age ?

questions.question: 9. The effect of temperature on reaction rate can be expressed by $K=A e^{-E_{a} / R T}$. Here $K$ is the rate constant and $\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}}$ is activation energy. The rate constant, K is $0.237 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and $2.64 \times$ $10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate the activation energy.

1. Indicate, whether the following statements are true or false. If false, give the correct information.
(a) Exterior beauty is more admired than brain in the society.
(b) The range of our wisdom and experience widens with the progress of time.
(c) Physical beauty gives us transitory pleasure.
(d) With time and age physical beauty enhances.
(e) Brain helps us to perform virtuous activities.
